summary_rationale: Aurobindo Pharma is a vertically integrated global generics, API, and emerging biologics/CDMO platform generating INR 33,653 Cr in FY26 revenue (and a record INR 10,263 Cr in Q2 FY27, +23.9% YoY, aided by the June 29, 2026 $245.7M Lannett acquisition alongside complex launches) with 20.4%–21.0% EBITDA margins, 113% 10-year CFO-to-PAT conversion, and a low 0.22x gross debt-to-equity balance sheet. Europe (>EUR 1B, +27% YoY in Q2 FY27), US complex launches (gAdvair, ADQUEY), clean Apitoria API USFDA VAI clearances (Unit-II and Unit-VI in Nov 2026), CuraTeQ EMA approvals with STADA, and TheraNym's Merck-anchored CDMO provide strong multi-engine growth. However, 5-year sales CAGR of 6.32%, ROCE compression from 27% to 13% (ROE 10.1%) amid INR 24,902 Cr in fixed assets plus CWIP (including INR 460.27 Cr provisional Lannett goodwill), 326-day inventory bloat, a widened four-site USFDA OAI/Warning Letter formulation backlog (Eugia Units I, II, III plus Lannett Seymour, Indiana OAI in Nov 2026), Pen-G's January 2027 DGFT MIP sunset cliff (pending DGTR anti-dumping probe), US Section 232 generic tariff review risk, and unresolved US multistate antitrust MDL exposure prevent an unconditional compounder classification until formulation remediation and asset turns normalize.
